comment: Duration defines a period between two time points.
Messages of this datatype are of ROS Time following this design:

fields.name: sec
comment: The seconds component, valid over all int32 values.

fields.name: nanosec
comment: The nanoseconds component, valid in the range [0, 1e9), to be added to the seconds component.
The duration -1.7 seconds is represented as {sec: -2, nanosec: 3e8}
The duration 1.7 seconds is represented as {sec: 1, nanosec: 7e8}
